preconditions.description: The input integer n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The input n is an integer.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(-10**9 <= int(coord) <= 10**9 for coord in line.split()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two integers x and y, both within the range [-10^9, 10^9].

postconditions.expression: len({(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in output_lines}) == n
postconditions.description: All n output coordinates are distinct.
The total number of knights after the process terminates is at least floor(n^2 / 10), where final_knight_count is the result of simulating the process starting from the output coordinates.
